data.name: Naaziraah
data.long_meaning: Naaziraah is a Quranic name derived from the root 'n-z-r', which means to guard, protect and preserve. The name is a reference to a woman who protects and preserves her faith, and is a symbol of strong and unwavering commitment to Islam. This name is often given to girls as a reminder of their role as guardians of their faith and their families.
